           MICROMERIA DOUGLASII

         Yerba Buena

        (MICROMERIA)


A California mint-like plant acting on stomach and bowels. Used as a tea
        to cure colic and relieve flatulence. Is a pleasant beverage and febrifuge, blood purifyer
        and tonic.



Stomach.--  Nausea; pain in stomach and bowels; flatulence.



Dose.--  Tincture.
